text:
Anna P: hey team, quick sync — we need a lightweight cadence for SI co-sell intake so partners know when to expect responses and who owns claims :wave:
Kevin L: +1. Are we aiming daily triage or a slower cadence (twice/week)?
Liam S: my vote is daily for hot leads, and a twice/week sweep for everything else. keeps momentum w/out eating ops time
Sarah M: agree. propose: 24h claim window for named accounts, 72h for net-new inbound. after window, auto-unclaim back to partner queue.
Anna P: can we codify that in a simple playbook? e.g. claim window rules, expected SLAs, and a nudge policy if SI hasn't responded in 36h :thinking_face:
Kevin L: yes — also need account mapping guidance: when SI claims an account but redwood sales already owns it, what are the steps? prefer: quick check in SFDC + handoff note, then partner rep and AE align within 48h
Liam S: ops automation idea: Integrations Bot posts a daily digest with claim status and flags conflicts. sample digest output:```
- 2026-03-20 08:00 UTC: 12 new claims, 3 conflicts
- conflict IDs: ACCT-342, ACCT-781
```
Anna P: that looks good. who can own the 48h conflict resolution SLA? recommend pairing Partner Success + AE lead on each conflict
Sarah M: Partner Success owns initial outreach, AE lead decides routing. If no resolution in 48h, escalate to Partnerships EMs.
Kevin L: for marketplace/hardware partner co-announces we should add a gating checklist: PR date, joint customer approval, support ping, and SI readiness sign-off. prevents last-minute drops
Anna P: can someone draft the 1-page playbook we can share with top 10 SIs? bullet list + chart for claim flow + sample messages
Liam S: I can draft by EOD tomorrow. will include the claim command we use in slack: `/si-claim <account-id> <partner>` and the auto-release timers
Sarah M: thx liam. also add a short FAQ for common edge cases (multi-region accounts, reseller chains)
Integrations Bot: reminder posted to #partnerships daily at 08:00 UTC with claim digest (automated) :robot_face:
Anna P: perfect — once liam posts draft we'll run a 30-min review with AEs and Partner Success. tagging @Kevin L to set calendar invites
Kevin L: on it. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
